name: cloudflare-product-search
description: Cloudflare product search and autocomplete for any site, using SuggestAPI for the product catalog and Cloudflare AI Search for docs and content.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build

SUGGESTAPI_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Your SuggestAPI public (search) key. Create one at [suggestapi.com](https://www.suggestapi.com).

SUGGESTAPI_INDEX.description: The SuggestAPI index that holds your product catalog, for example `products`.
